decision_points.question: How are records with missing player height/weight measurements handled?
decision_points.why_rival: each record with a missing anthropometric value is either dropped via listwise/complete-case deletion or filled by some median-imputation scheme; an analyst constructs the sample one way, not both

decision_points.question: How are records with a missing referee bias (IAT/explicit) score handled?
decision_points.why_rival: each disposes of rows lacking a referee prejudice measurement one way — require/drop them (complete-case on the bias variable) versus impute/fill and keep them

decision_points.question: Which control variables and functional forms enter the regression model?
decision_points.why_rival: each is a complete alternative covariate specification for the primary model; the analyst fits one set of controls, so choosing one precludes the others

decision_points.question: How are the continuous predictors transformed and standardized before modeling?
decision_points.why_rival: each is a rival scaling/transformation scheme (z-scoring, log-transform, or both) applied to the same continuous predictors

decision_points.question: How is the referee implicit-bias (IAT) column's string 'NA' parsed to numeric?
decision_points.why_rival: single recorded choice for coercing the IAT column's 'NA' strings to numeric/missing
